bioAdditions: FamilySearch tree 2ZSS-9R1 lists Jacob Pringle, born 1828 in Luzerne Co., among the children of Benjamin Pringle and Charity Gould. It records his marriage to Ellen C. Fuller (1830-1898) at Plymouth in April 1864, and his census residence in Falls Twp., Wyoming Co., in 1870 and 1880. It names two daughters: Carry (b. 1865) and Emma C. (b. 15 Sep 1867, d. 1960) (S1). One attached record is indexed as 'Jacob G Pr[ingle]', which supports the middle initial G (for Gould). The tree gives no death date.
openQuestionsNew: Death date and place unknown (after 1880; Falls Twp., Wyoming Co.?)
